screen: M1 low-version tertiary road share county-held-out residual correction; unregistered

method.feature: Frozen M1|R|covariate:low_version_tertiary_share aggregate: share of provided Overture tertiary road length whose supplied OSM way sources.record_id version, after deduplicating IDs and averaging versions for each geometry, is <=2. The version token is parsed only from ^w[0-9]+@([0-9]+)$ record IDs; no other road classes contribute.
method.source_guard: No OSM history retrieval or other version/vintage source. Only the pinned M1 artifact is read for the feature; M1 provenance is checked against its source code and harness reports.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen cross-fitted S1 Queen/Rook disagreement residual; neither recomputed nor refit.
method.validation: For each official region, hold out each supported five-digit county FIPS as a fixed leave-one-county-out fold; fit on all other supported counties in that region. Every supported tract is predicted exactly once.
method.correction: OLS intercept plus one linear term; standardize the feature with training-fold mean and population SD only (zero SD scale becomes 1). No threshold search or additional predictors.
method.baseline: Unmodified frozen S1 residual (zero correction), scored on identical held-out support.
method.metric: Incremental ΔR²=(zero-correction baseline SSE - county-held-out corrected SSE)/baseline SSE, pooled and by region; paired county bootstrap within each region.
method.urban_rural: Report support and analogous paired correction deltas using provided pct_urban <0.5 rural, >=0.5 urban; strata are descriptive only.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only, not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSEs; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

interpretation: One or more preregistered held-out gates failed; retain descriptive-only and do not integrate.
